about_the_game:
At the start of the round, players have to figure out who killed the Don. They can do so by searching Clues. When enough Clues are delivered to the Clue Processing Unit, a Traitor will be revealed. Traitors are consipring against the Innocents, Detective and Doctor. The game is won by Traitors if they eliminate all Innocents. The Innocents win by finding and killing the Traitors.

Classes:

  • Slim class: Quick but weak
    Adrenaline - Temporarily increases movement speed.
    HP: 80.
    Movement speed: +10%.
    Medium and Shotgun ammo does 15% more damage.

  • Medium class: Balanced
    Medkit - Heals 25 hp.
    HP: 100.
    Medium and Sniper ammo does 7% more damage.

  • Heavy class: Slow but strong
    Shield - Temporarily decreases incoming damage by 30%.
    HP: 110.
    Light ammo does 10% more damage.

Role abilities/gadgets:

  • Innocent: Find clues to snuff out Traitors.

    Class ability - Changed by class.

  • Traitor: Eliminate all Innocents.

    Revive - Revive a dead body
    Radar - Reveal player locations
    Bomb - Plant bombs
    Poison Dart - Slows players
    Silenced Pistol - Silent shots
    Bear Trap - Trap players
    Disguise - Hide your identity
    Spiked Bat - Deadly bat

  • Detective: Scan bodies to publicly confirm deaths.

    Shield - Decreases incoming damage
    DNA Scan - Reveal the body's killer
    Radar - Reveal player locations.
    Taser - Stuns and make player drop their weapon
    Doctor Resuscitate - Brings unconscious doctor back

  • Doctor: Resuscitate unconscious people.

    Defibrillator - Resuscitate an unconscious person
    Unconscious Radar - Reveal locations of unconscious bodies
    Adrenaline - Increases movement speed
    Health station - Players can take hp

  • Zombie Traitor: Help Traitors.

    Radar - Reveal player locations
    Bomb - Plant bombs

  • Zombie Don: Help Innocents.

    Adrenaline - Increases movement speed
    Shield - Decreases incoming damage

- Clue Processing Unit system:
At the start of the round, the body of the Don appears. When a player finds this body, clues will be spawned over the map and players will have to collect them. If they bring enough clues to the C.P.U., one of the Traitors will be revealed. Watch out for Traitors sabotaging the C.P.U. by turning off the power!

Join our Discord community!

Treason is a hobby project with a small but active and friendly community. Use the Discord server to look for players, if the game servers are empty.

short_description: Treason is a 3-16 player party shooter of teamwork and betrayal, set among Italian mobsters. Use proximity voice chat, unique abilities/gadgets, and strategy to prove your innocence or deceive others.
